description: Exact generalized-roundness exponent of intrinsic shortest-path metrics on line graphs of binary hypercubes, including endpoint spectral nullity, minimal squared-Euclidean dimension, and exponential dimension asymptotic.
integrity: The finite checker is standalone and replays independently generated graph-distance matrices; primary infinite assertions are supported by an analytic proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted binary hypercube line graphs; not arbitrary edge graphs or Euclidean edge-midpoint metrics.
Finite checker supports rather than replaces the all-dimension proof.
No exhaustive independent historical priority determination.
title: Sharp generalized roundness of hypercube line graphs
